title: The signed height of BMP determines the row direction of uncompressed RGB
summary: For uncompressed RGB of BITMAPINFOHEADER, positive heights are typically bottom-up and negative heights are top-down.
applies: Windows BMP; BITMAPINFOHEADER vs. uncompressed RGB
detail: When representing an image in two-dimensional coordinates, the same number of rows may be mapped in reverse order.
boundary: Some YUV and compression formats have different conventions for height; other older DIB headers do not necessarily have the same signed fields.
relevance: Ability to differentiate between row ordering issues and pixel value errors when the image area content is completely correct but vertically reversed.
